source_identity: The Weather Company Kalshi Domestic Daily Climate relay of the named NWS Daily Climate Report CLI product and station; event rule identity must match each city
settlement_window_rule: midnight inclusive to next midnight exclusive, fixed local standard time; no DST shift
settlement_domain: source-reported full-precision Fahrenheit Decimal; observed CLI maxima are integer Fahrenheit but integer-only future settlement is unproven; reject non-integer settlement from any integer-only analysis rather than round
grid_selection_rule: Use the exact A0 Earth Engine reviewed nearest 0.05-degree grid cell to the named NWS station; verify returned sample geometry equals frozen center for every row; reject wrong-city or changed point
initialization_rule: exact target UTC date 00:00Z WeatherNext initialization only; all 24 valid-hour images must share this init
forecast_rule: daily_max_p50_proxy = max(hourly station_head_temperature_2m_p50) over exactly the city's 24 authoritative CLI valid hours; no bias correction, city tuning, probability model, or rounding
execution_rule: one attempt per city/date; scientific acquisition may start only [decision_time, decision_time + 5 minutes); early wrapper may wait without scientific queries or claim; data must be ingested strictly before decision time; fail closed on missing, duplicate, late, or wrong-point hours
pre_outcome_rule: seal immutable forecast, weather and public market evidence before settlement, outcome lookup, scoring, or any model update; no outcome API path in acquisition runtime
market_sibling_rule: Discover exact event ticker {series_ticker}-{YYMONDD}; require exactly six unique active sibling tickers with that prefix, one lower tail T, four bounded B, one upper tail T, ordered contiguous integer-Fahrenheit ladder endpoints; use structured strike_type/floor_strike/cap_strike and exact event rule CLI, never title-only or rounded p50 parsing; reject changed shape or bounds
market_snapshot_rule: At scientific decision capture event, all sibling market objects, bid/ask and sizes, per-sibling public depth, rules and bounds with retrieval timestamps; fail city-day if incomplete or inactive
cloud_design: separate Cloud Run job, dedicated EE read-only OAuth, create-only GCS objects with generation precondition zero, atomic claims/{city}/{YYYYMMDD}.json, zero task and scheduler retries, per-city failure isolation; Chicago job and evidence excluded
